# Plan: Fix Accessibility ARIA Roles on Catalog Page

## Bug Description

Three axe accessibility violations on `/products/catalog.html`:

1. **`aria-required-children`** — Elements with an ARIA role must contain required child roles. The card collection container is missing `role="list"` and the `merch-card[variant="catalog"]` elements are missing `role="listitem"`, breaking the required list/listitem hierarchy.

2. **`aria-required-parent`** — Elements with an ARIA role must be contained by required parent roles. Same root cause as above: `merch-card[variant="catalog"]` elements lack `role="listitem"` and are not inside a `role="list"` container.

3. **Special Offers link missing `aria-label`** — The `sp-sidenav-item` for Special Offers in the Resources section has no `aria-label`. Screen readers cannot identify the link target.

## Root Cause

- `MerchCard` (`merch-card.js`) does not set `role="listitem"` on the host element for the `catalog` variant.
- `MerchCardCollection` (`merch-card-collection.js`) does not set `role="list"` on its host element when displaying catalog cards.
- The `sp-sidenav-item` for Special Offers in `catalog-sidenav.test.html` is missing `target="_blank"` and `aria-label` attributes.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action |
|------|--------|
| `web-components/src/merch-card.js` | Add `role="listitem"` to host element for `catalog` variant in `connectedCallback` and `willUpdate` |
| `web-components/src/merch-card-collection.js` | Add `role="list"` to the `merch-card-collection` host element for catalog variant |
| `web-components/test/sidenav/catalog-sidenav.test.html` | Add `target="_blank"` and `aria-label` to the Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add `role="listitem"` to `merch-card` for catalog variant

**File:** `web-components/src/merch-card.js`

- In `connectedCallback()`, after the existing setup, add:
  ```js
  if (this.variant === 'catalog') {
      this.setAttribute('role', 'listitem');
  }
  ```
- In `willUpdate(changedProperties)`, after handling variant/variantLayout changes, add:
  ```js
  if (changedProperties.has('variant')) {
      if (this.variant === 'catalog') {
          this.setAttribute('role', 'listitem');
      } else {
          this.removeAttribute('role');
      }
  }
  ```

### 2. Add `role="list"` to `merch-card-collection` for catalog variant

**File:** `web-components/src/merch-card-collection.js`

- In the `MerchCardCollection` `connectedCallback()`, set `role="list"` when the collection's variant is `catalog`. Find where `variant` is consumed and add:
  ```js
  if (this.variant === 'catalog') {
      this.setAttribute('role', 'list');
  }
  ```
- In `willUpdate(changedProperties)` (or `updated()`), react to `variant` changes:
  ```js
  if (changedProperties.has('variant')) {
      if (this.variant === 'catalog') {
          this.setAttribute('role', 'list');
      } else {
          this.removeAttribute('role');
      }
  }
  ```

### 3. Fix Special Offers link `aria-label` in catalog sidenav

**File:** `web-components/test/sidenav/catalog-sidenav.test.html`

- Locate the `sp-sidenav-item` for Special Offers in the Resources section (line ~96):
  ```html
  <sp-sidenav-item href="/products/special-offers.html">
  ```
- Add `target="_blank"` and `aria-label` following the Milo pattern:
  ```html
  <sp-sidenav-item
      href="/products/special-offers.html"
      target="_blank"
      aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab">
  ```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `merch-card[variant="catalog"]` elements have `role="listitem"` on the host element
- [ ] The `merch-card-collection` container for catalog variant has `role="list"` on the host element
- [ ] `aria-required-children` and `aria-required-parent` axe violations are resolved
- [ ] Special Offers `sp-sidenav-item` has `aria-label="Open the Special Offers page in a new tab"` and `target="_blank"`
- [ ] No regressions in existing catalog tests (`merch-card.catalog.test.html.js`)

## Validation Commands

```bash
node --check web-components/src/merch-card.js
node --check web-components/src/merch-card-collection.js
```
